capabilities: create child and sibling nodes via keyboard shortcuts
navigate and select nodes without the mouse
edit nodes in a distraction-free creation view
build knowledge graphs on Obsidian Canvas
extras: Pre-release: the author asks users not to open bug or support requests yet. Planned but unimplemented features include import from XMind/Lark, export to other formats, layouts and collision detection.
motivation: The author, describing themselves as an accessibility enthusiast, wants to create without taking hands off the keyboard.
problem: Obsidian Canvas lacks fast, keyboard-only mindmap node creation and navigation, forcing mouse interaction.
summary: Keyboard-driven mindmap plugin for Obsidian Canvas with node creation, navigation and editing via shortcuts.
